svg.text: Lab 03 · Switching & Redundancy — Rapid-PVST · EtherChannel (LACP/PAgP/static) · HSRP · Port-Security · VTP v3
DHCP: R1 pools, relay via SVI helper
• Rapid-PVST: STP root = HSRP active per VLAN
• EtherChannel: Po1 LACP · Po2 PAgP · Po3 static "on"
• HSRP load-share: Core1 = VLAN 10/30, Core2 = VLAN 20
• Every access switch dual-homed to both distribution switches
• VTP v3 domain ROMANVTP: Core1 primary server, all others clients
• VLANs/VTP live in vlan.dat, not the export: rebuild after import
